part.summary: Where the member records live today and how to bring them into one register.

section.title: Registers in use
section.p: Records are split between a spreadsheet, a paper ledger and the treasurer's laptop; the annual fee is per member.

list.item:
The spreadsheet on the club computer:
one sheet per season;
one row per member, with a "paid" column.
a sheet for the junior squad.
The paper ledger, kept in the office drawer.

section.title: Rules for the new register
section.p: Records of former members are kept for after they leave, then deleted.

section.title: Who can read it
section.p: Only the secretary and the treasurer; questions go to secretary@lakeside-rowing.example.
